config.name: isaac_g1_kitchen
config._note: Frozen before any Isaac execution (25 Oct 2026). Scenes: NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.2 replicator_kitchen layouts, authored by NVIDIA, never seen by DREAM's agent during development. l_shape is the only development kitchen (locomotion bring-up and pipeline debugging). g_shape, l_island, peninsula and u_shape are evaluation kitchens: no code or threshold may change after seeing their episodes while still calling them held-out. The agent is the Milestone B agent unchanged (RoomSearchPlanner 'gain'); this measures transfer, it is not a tuned result. Starts: a free floor cell at least start_clearance_m from every collider footprint, drawn with seed [start, 7]; heading uniform. Bring-up uses the deterministic deepest-cell / longest-clear-heading rule instead.

bringup._gates: Milestone A gates (results/g1_locomotion): no fall, 10 s standing drift <= 0.2 m, tracking ratio 0.75-1.1; head RGB-D valid.

evaluation_gates._note: Pre-registered for the 12 evaluation episodes. Success threshold equals Milestone B's shifted-room gate. Contacts with furniture and phantom handles are reported, not gated.
